answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow: each identity locks 60 POA, freed only as a unique fingerprint forms. Like a prism, it splits activity into bands — hours, tasks, counterparties — and matching prints betray one operator: a copy leaves an echo in timing and partners, so the cluster is frozen and slashed. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA, all lost. An honest agent pays once, unlocks its deposit by working, and earns an ivory badge.
